Washington governor, union denounce ICE arrests of travellers at Seattle airport

A person holds a sign as people gather for a protest at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, after U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers arrested two people boarding an Alaska Airlines flight earlier in the day, in SeaTac, Washington, US on Nov 21, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/David Ryder)

The governor of Washington state denounced federal immigration authorities on Saturday (Nov 21) for arresting two people on a jetway at a Seattle-area airport.
The incident involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers occurred around 8am PST at the Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as people boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles. ICE officers conducted an operation to arrest Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, who overstayed his visa, the agency said in a statement.
The officers also arrested a second individual, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, who threw hot coffee at them, ICE said in a post on social media. Mejia had also overstayed her visa, ICE said, adding that she would be charged with assaulting a federal officer.
Reuters was not able to identify lawyers for Mendoza or Mejia.

"ICE is completely and totally out of control and today we are confronted with yet more evidence of this," said Governor Bob Ferguson, a Democrat, at a news conference on Saturday.
Video of the incident circulated on social media and news outlets is "horrific" and "chilling", Ferguson said, adding that he told Alaska Airlines representatives that “they need to call on ICE to get out of our airports."
The governor said he would make the same request of every other airline that flies out of Sea-Tac airport.
Alaska Airlines said it is "concerned" by the federal action.
"Alaska Airlines was not provided advance notice of the enforcement action and we are working to understand the circumstances surrounding what occurred," the company said in a statement.
April Sims, president of the Washington State Labor Council called the ICE arrest a "smash-and-grab" action that injected fear and chaos during a delicate time for air travel.
"Just days after our nation experienced widespread disruptions to air travel and flights being grounded, federal agents chose to carry out this operation at one of our busiest airports, during one the busiest travel weeks of the year," Sims said in a statement sent by the union, which includes local chapters representing flight attendants and ground crew at Sea-Tac airport.
Alaska Airlines said many passengers were put on other flights shortly after the incident and the originally scheduled flight departed at 11am.

Source: Reuters/nh

items.title: Govt tightens terms for extending contracts of 7 pre-NELP oil, gas blocks
items.author: Press Trust of India
items.summary: Under revised policy, extensions can be granted in one or more instalments of up to 30 years each, for both oil and gas fields, subject to their continued commercial viability ...
items.body: The government has revised its policy for extending production-sharing contracts (PSCs) for seven pre-New Exploration Licensing Policy (Pre-NELP) oil and gas blocks, allowing extensions until the end of a field's economic life while stipulating higher government profit shares, minimum performance requirements and investment commitments.Under the revised policy, notified by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas on November 10, extensions can be granted in one or more instalments of up to 30 years each, for both oil and gas fields, subject to their continued commercial viability.The government will receive a higher share of profit petroleum during the extended contract period, with its share set at 10 percentage points above the rate calculated under normal PSC provisions for the first 10 years of extension, five percentage points higher for the next 10 years and 2.5 percentage points higher for the following 10 years. Thereafter, the normal PSC provisions will apply.The revised policy supersedes the framework issued in April 2017 and follows the notification of the Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Amendment Act, 2025, and the Petroleum and Natural Gas Rules, 2025.The seven blocks covered by the policy are : RJ-ON-90/1 and SGL (RJ-ON/6) in Rajasthan; Dirok AAP-ON-94/1 and AA-ONJ/2 in Assam and Assam-Mizoram; and Tarapur (CB-ON/2), Palej-Pramoda (CB-ON/7) and CB-ON/3 in Gujarat.Under the new framework, contractors can apply for an extension after completing half the original contract term or its extended term, but must submit their applications at least two years before the contract expires.The Directorate General of Hydrocarbons (DGH) will make its recommendation within six months of receiving an application, while the government will decide within three months of receiving the DGH proposal.To qualify, contractors must demonstrate the availability of remaining recoverable reserves through a third-party reserves audit and submit a field development plan or revised field development plan covering the proposed extension period.The plan must include estimates of remaining reserves, future production profiles based on reservoir simulation studies, proposed work programmes and estimated expenditure, according to the notification.For development areas with remaining recoverable 2P/P50 reserves exceeding 5 million barrels of oil equivalent, the reserves audit must be conducted by an internationally reputed consultant from a panel maintained by the DGH.Contractors must also demonstrate satisfactory past performance. They should have either drilled at least 70 per cent of the development wells specified in the approved field development plan over the preceding 10 years or achieved at least 70 per cent of committed production under the approved field operating plan or work programme during the same period.They must also have cleared all statutory dues payable to the government, demonstrate technical expertise and comply with site restoration fund and site restoration plan requirements.The policy requires contractors to furnish a bank guarantee equivalent to 10 per cent of the total estimated annual expenditure under the work programme approved by the Management Committee. A grace period of up to one year may be allowed for completing delayed work, subject to an extension of the bank guarantee and other conditions.During the extended period, royalties and cess will be payable at prevailing rates applicable under the nomination regime, with contractors contributing in proportion to their participating interests.The government has retained the option to invite fresh bids if contractors fail to meet the prescribed eligibility and performance conditions. It can also assign fields to national oil companies, including Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) and Oil India Ltd (OIL).The government has reserved the right to refuse an extension without assigning reasons and to impose additional conditions specific to individual contracts. Contractors unwilling to accept the revised policy will have their fields considered for rebidding on an as-is-where-is basis.The revised framework also provides that contractors can choose the seat of arbitration in accordance with Rule 51 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Rules, 2025.Existing extensions granted under the 2017 policy will remain valid until their scheduled expiry under the terms already approved. However, all first-time extension applications beyond the original PSC term, as well as applications for further extensions beyond currently approved periods, will be governed by the revised policy.

items.title: Oil, gas import bill up 60% in Oct as Brent surges, LPG use declines
items.author: Press Trust of India
items.summary: Direct private LPG imports fell 83.8 per cent in October and 97.3 per cent in April-October. Packed domestic LPG sales by state-run companies fell 11.8 per cent in October, and bulk LPG sales fell ...
items.body: India's net oil and gas import bill rose 60 per cent year-on-year to $16 billion in October as Brent crude averaged $124.77 a barrel, almost double that of a year earlier, according to data from the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (PPAC), part of the oil ministry.The net bill was $10.0 billion in October 2025. Crude imports alone cost $19.5 billion, against $10.4 billion a year ago, even though volumes rose only 11 per cent to 23.3 million tonnes. LNG imports cost $1.3 billion, and petroleum product exports brought in $6.3 billion.Brent averaged $116.77 in September and $64.75 in October 2025. The Indian basket averaged $119.91 in October, against $65.08 a year earlier.Over April-October, the net import bill reached $97.7 billion, up from $70.3 billion a year earlier. Crude imports rose 2.7 per cent in volume but cost $111.0 billion, against $72.3 billion.Consumption of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) fell 12.3 per cent in October and 15.1 per cent in April-October. The number of active domestic LPG customers stood at 32.6 crore on November 1, down from 33.4 crore on April 1, the PPAC data showed.Direct private LPG imports fell 83.8 per cent in October and 97.3 per cent in April-October. Packed domestic LPG sales by state-run companies fell 11.8 per cent in October, and bulk LPG sales fell 49.1 per cent. Auto LPG sales rose 23.9 per cent.Imports of petroleum products fell 41.2 per cent in October and 49.3 per cent in the fiscal year so far. PPAC attributed the fiscal-year decline mainly to lower imports of LPG, pet coke and fuel oil.The International Energy Agency said in its World Energy Outlook 2026 that LPG imports fell by over 50 per cent in the first two months of shipping disruption through the Strait of Hormuz.Other fuels held up better. Diesel consumption rose 12 per cent in October to 8.5 million tonnes, petrol rose 3.5 per cent, and bitumen rose 16.5 per cent. Total petroleum product consumption rose 2.7 per cent to 20.5 million tonnes in October. It was still down 3.2 per cent in April-October at 134.2 million tonnes.Natural gas consumption fell 7.27 per cent to 5,707 million standard cubic metres in October. LNG imports fell 6.94 per cent to 3,014 million standard cubic metres.India processed 24.1 million tonnes of crude in October, up 7.1 per cent, or about 5.70 million barrels a day. Of that, 22.0 million tonnes were imported crude, and domestic output was 2.1 million tonnes. Imports met 88.7 per cent of crude consumption in October.Domestic crude and condensate output was 2.3 million tonnes. Import dependency for natural gas stood at 52.8 per cent in October.Ethanol blending in petrol stood at 20 per cent in October, PPAC data showed.

LAS VEGAS, Nov 21 : Red Bull's Max Verstappen won a crazy, slipstreaming Las Vegas Grand Prix for the third time in four years on Saturday, while Mercedes rival George Russell hit the barriers late on and finished ninth.
In a race of 35 lead changes over 50 laps, and drivers nose-to-tail under the floodlights with track advantage swinging back and forth like a yo-yo, McLaren's 2025 champion Lando Norris and teammate Oscar Piastri finished second and third behind the polesitter.
Ferrari drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc collided again in a race in which both collected 10-second penalties for separate incidents and finished seventh and 10th respectively.
"That was crazy. Really, really surreal and something I've never seen before in Formula One myself," said Verstappen, who beat Norris by 0.639 seconds.

"It was a crazy amount of fighting and the slipstream was so big that it was just impossible to drive off and it was just crazy how many people were just following." 
Mercedes have already won both titles, with 20-year-old Italian Kimi Antonelli this month becoming the youngest ever Formula One world champion, while Verstappen and Russell started the weekend scrapping to end the season as overall runner-up.
Verstappen's fourth win in six races sent him 37 points clear of Ferrari's Hamilton with Russell, who started on the front row, dropping to fourth overall and level with Norris.
Antonelli was fourth with Alpine's Pierre Gasly fifth and teammate Franco Colapinto sixth. Carlos Sainz was eighth for Williams in the Spaniard's 250th race.
"I think that must have been the most chaotic race ever in the history of Formula One," said Norris.
"I didn't know what was happening half the time. I didn't know if I was going to have the best race and have a chance to win or end up last. It had everything this race."
Piastri, who started 17th, could only agree.
"They say Las Vegas is the entertainment capital of the world and that was pretty entertaining to be a part of," said the Australian.
"It was pretty random. You would pass someone on one straight super easy, then the next straight you would struggle and then with someone else it would be different strengths and weaknesses." 
(Writing by Alan Baldwin in London, editing by Peter Rutherford)

items.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
items.summary: Cross-chain swap protocol Chainflip confirmed that an attacker stole about $12 million in Bitcoin, Ether and stablecoins from its vaults on Saturday, expanding the initially reported $4.86 million ...
items.body:
News
/ Cointelegraph
/ Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty

Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty Less than 1 min read

BTCUSD ETHUSD
Cross-chain swap protocol Chainflip confirmed that an attacker stole about $12 million in Bitcoin, Ether and stablecoins from its vaults on Saturday, expanding the initially reported $4.86 million loss.
In a statement addressed to the attacker, Chainflip Labs said 122.86 Bitcoin BTCUSD , 520.22 Ether ETHUSD , 3.25 million USDC and 758,141 USDT were stolen in the Saturday incident.
The company offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return the remaining 90% of stolen assets by 18:38 UTC on Nov. 23. Chainflip said it would treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw its reports and complaints to law enforcement if the funds were returned before the deadline.
According to CoinGecko data, Chainflip’s FLIP token plunged 42.9% over the past 24 hours.
Chainflip said it had traced preparations for the attack to Tornado Cash funding on Nov. 11 and a validator account registered on Friday.
The company said it had identified the mechanism behind the cryptographic key exposure and taken steps to prevent similar attacks. It also said it obtained identifying information linked to the attacker that could assist law enforcement.
“We hold identifying information on the validator and servers used, your addresses are flagged across every major analytics firm, and every Tornado Cash withdrawal is being watched,” Chainflip said.

Shimla: An earthquake of magnitude 2.8 struck Shimla district in Himachal Pradesh on Sunday morning, according to the National Centre for Seismology (NCS).

The earthquake occurred at 6:29:02 am IST on November 22 at a depth of 8 kilometres, the NCS said in a post on X.

According to the seismic data shared by the agency, the epicentre was located at latitude 31.422 degrees north and longitude 77.783 degrees east in Shimla district of Himachal Pradesh.

Show Full Article

The NCS shared the earthquake details on its official social media handle, providing the magnitude, depth and geographical coordinates of the seismic event.

Earlier on August 14, an earthquake of magnitude 3.0 struck Chamba in Himachal Pradesh on Friday, reported the National Centre of Seismology (NCS).

The earthquake hit the district at 06:36 am.

Sharing the details on its website, the NCS said, “M: 3.0 – Chamba, Himachal Pradesh, Origin Time: 2026-08-14 06:36:28 IST, Latitude: 33.131, Longitude: 76.585, Depth: 5 km.

“In a post on X, NCS said: “EQ of M: 3.0, On: 14/08/2026 06:36:28 IST, Lat: 33.131 N, Long: 76.585 E, Depth: 5 Km, Location: Chamba, Himachal Pradesh.”

Earthquakes can occur anywhere between the Earth’s surface and about 700 kilometres below the surface. For scientific purposes, the earthquake depth range of 0 700 km is divided into three zones: shallow, intermediate, and deep, as per USGS data.

Shallow earthquakes are between 0 and 70 km deep; intermediate earthquakes, 70 -300 km deep; and deep earthquakes, 300 – 700 km deep. In general, the term “deep-focus earthquakes” is applied to earthquakes deeper than 70 km, the United States Geological Survey (USGS) states.

items.title: ＥＵ加盟国はロシア人の入国制限強化を、デンマークが提案　暗殺未遂受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
John Irish

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
John Irish

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - デンマークは、米ウクライナ二重国籍の男性ラッパーに対するロシアの暗殺計画を阻止したと発表したのに続き、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟国に文書を送り、ロシア国民への入国制限を強化するよう呼びかけた。外交関係者が文書の内容を確認した。

デンマークの警察と治安当局は２０日、ロシア情報機関が９月下旬にコペンハーゲンで公演を控えていた男性ラッパーの暗殺を企てたが、直前に関係する３人を逮捕したと明らかにした。ラスムセン外相はこれを「容認できない」と非難し、デンマーク政府はロシアの駐在武官の国外追放も発表した。

デンマークはＥＵ加盟国の外交担当者に２０日夜に送った文書で、欧州域内の自由な往来を保障するシェンゲン協定締結２９カ国への入国に関し、ロシア国民への観光ビザ（査証）の発給停止や、ロシアの非生体認証パスポートでの本人確認を停止することを提案した。

週明け２３日に開かれるＥＵの事務レベルの会議で提案を示す見通し。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は２１日、各地で試合を行い、八村塁が所属するクリッパーズはマーベリックスに１００─１１０で敗れた。

先発した八村は約２９分プレーし、１９得点、８リバウンド、１アシストだった。クリッパーズは３連敗。

セブンティシクサーズはバックスを１３２─１２９で下し、５連勝。東カンファレンストップの１４勝３敗とした。シクサーズのジョエル・エンビードが２６得点、１７リバウンド、９アシストと活躍。レブロン・ジェームズが２１得点、６リバウンド、６アシスト、３スチールで貢献した。バックスはタイラー・ヒーローがキャリア最多の５０得点を挙げたが、１３連敗となった。

スパーズはビクター・ウェンバンヤマが５０得点、１９リバウンドと活躍し、ペリカンズに１１４─９１で快勝した。ティンバーウルブズはグリズリーズに１０４─９５で勝利。ニックスはトレイルブレーザーズに９７─９６で競り勝った。

items.title: Wall Street asks what can save AI trade after Anthropic wipeout
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Wall Street is struggling to find reasons to buy as the AI trade comes under pressure following Anthropic’s lacklustre post-IPO performance. A sharp selloff in tech stocks, mounting concerns over AI-related risks and an expected Federal Reserve rate hike have dampened investor sentiment, leaving markets searching for fresh catalysts to revive the rally.
items.body: It’s been a tough month for the stock market, rocked by back-to-back punches from the stunning ouster of Jensen Huang from Nvidia Corp. and the Democrats’ decisive victory in the midterm elections.Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering this week was supposed to provide some relief and change the mood. It didn’t. Instead, it raised more questions about the struggling artificial intelligence trade, and tech stocks continued to sell off, led by chipmakers, with Nasdaq 100 Index tumbling 10% for the week, its worst performance since the Covid pandemic hit in March 2020.Now, with few positive catalysts and a series of obvious risks on the horizon, starting with the Federal Reserve’s expected interest-rate hike next month, Wall Street is wondering what will inspire stocks to start climbing again. Instead of finding inspiration to buy, investors just keep discovering reasons to sell, as seemingly every other news headline — from air travel shutdowns to financial hacks — fuels suspicion that technology isn’t adapting to the risks posed by AI.“The market is in limbo-land, especially when it comes to tech and AI,” said Paul Nolte, market strategist and senior wealth manager at Murphy & Sylvest Wealth Management. “You need to gird your loins and expect a period of volatility and downside risk.”136067477The Anthropic deal could mark the end of the AI trade, Anna Wong, an economist with Bloomberg Economics, wrote in a report on Thursday. The company’s financials show weakening pricing power for frontier intelligence, she wrote, meaning that even with all the demand for AI services, leading providers are having trouble getting customers to pay enough for it to justify their spending.Of course, in a vacuum, Anthropic’s IPO did fine. It was priced over its targeted range, and when combined with a separate private placement of shares, the company raised the most cash for a new issue ever, topping SpaceX’s deal in June. The stock even raced higher out of the gate. But it quickly plateaued and then started retreating. By the end of Friday it was less than $6 from where it went public.The bigger issue is it ushered in more selling rather than giving investors a reason to buy. By the end of Friday, the Nasdaq 100 was teetering on the brink of bear market, defined as a 20% decline from a recent high, while the S&P 500 Index had entered a correction after falling 12% from its October record.Skeptical TimesAll that selling laid bare the magnitude of the questions swirling around AI more than four years into a bull market powered by huge bets on the technology.“There was a hope that the Anthropic IPO would provide a sustained boost, but the trading there is indicative of the broader concerns surrounding AI,” said Jim Baird, chief investment officer at Plante Moran Financial Advisors. “Anthropic came to market at a time of more general skepticism surrounding the space, and there are a lot of questions about their ability in the near term to deliver on increasingly lofty expectations.”Democratic victories in the midterms raised the risk that data center construction will slow since many of the party’s candidates ran on blocking their development. Meanwhile, the risk of higher interest rates raises the cost of capital as big data center developers increasingly turn to credit markets for funding.“A lot of the growth in AI is dependent on how and whether companies can fund their capital needs,” said Malcolm Polley, director of strategic market analysis at Stratos Investment Management, which has $3.6 billion in assets. “Will they need to fund that through capital or debt markets? Until we know the cost of capital, we can’t adequately value the asset, and if the cost of capital is going higher, then valuations need to come down.”But it’s the chaos at Nvidia that really has spooked investors. The company ousted Huang on Nov. 12 after he admitted having an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, and the stock has been in a tailspin ever since. Even a strong earnings report featuring a raised revenue forecast for next fiscal year and a $150 billion stock buyback authorization couldn’t stop the selling, as the question remained who will be Huang’s permanent replacement.Nvidia shares plunged 23% this week, their worst performance since 2008. The stock is down 48% from an Oct. 6 all-time high.The turmoil appeared to create openings for Nvidia’s competitors, including chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices Inc. But that bet took a hit on Thursday when a short seller raised questions about AMD’s business in China, which could be hurt by more US chip export restrictions. The shares plunged 20% in the final two sessions of the week.More broadly, it’s the sustainability of the hundreds of billions of dollars being spent to expand computing power that’s driving the selloff. That spending has juiced earnings for companies across the AI ecosystem, from chipmakers and networking gear manufacturers to electricity providers and industrial companies. But investors are increasingly skeptical that it can last.Chip Stocks SwingThis rapid swing from greed to fear is best seen in the trading of semiconductor stocks this year. Chips are historically a cyclical business, rising with demand and then falling as it dissipates. But the belief was that this history would be rewritten as years of AI demand would break the cycle. The Philadelphia Stock Exchange Semiconductor Index more than doubled in the first half of the year on that bet. But it has lost 41% in the second half as investors rethink those positions.136067484Memory and storage stocks, which also are major beneficiaries of the AI spending, have been among the hardest hit over the last few months. Sandisk Corp. was leading the S&P 500 in the first six months of year, soaring 857%. It’s the worst stock in the index in the second half, dropping 72%. Western Digital Corp. has tumbled more than 65% from a June record, while Micron Technology Inc. is down more than 50% from its all-time high.Of course, some optimism remains on Wall Street. In particular the hope is the selloff is nearing exhaustion as investors have used the opportunity to reduce risk, according to Brian Smedley, chief investment officer and head of Cynosure Strategies, the hedge fund division of the Cynosure Group.“I think investors will gain confidence that AI demand remains exceptionally strong, and that the key players — Anthropic among them — will continue to have very healthy growth prospects,” he said. “The market has overshot to the downside, just as it overshot to the upside earlier this year.”One thing investors agree on is that Anthropic’s debut will provide a new level of visibility into the business of selling AI services.“It has been hard to get a real feel for AI demand, and Anthropic is the answer to that question,” said Marta Norton, chief investment strategist at Empower. “We will know more about the upside of AI, in terms of demand and the return, at the same time that we will be getting a reinforced view of how crazy wildly expensive it is.”In the meantime, strategists are advising clients to stay nimble.“It’s hard to say what it might take to catalyze gains after this week,” said Mark Luschini, chief market strategist at Janney Montgomery Scott. “I want to see whether this selloff metastasizes into something more severe. We’re oversold, but not deeply so. We could plumb lower still. I want to see stabilization before I make a strong commitment.”

SYDNEY, Nov 22 : Australia fast bowler Josh Hazlewood said he and Usman Khawaja were never particularly close but that he bore no resentment towards his former teammate over an autobiography which has reignited debate around the 2018 ball-tampering scandal.
Khawaja alleged in his book that knowledge of the plan to use sandpaper on the ball during the tour of South Africa extended beyond the three players who were sanctioned over the scandal.
Hazlewood has said he had no knowledge of the plot and the 35-year-old suggested his limited interaction with Khawaja outside the team environment may explain why he was unaware of any such discussions.
"In any work environment, whether it be sport or in the office, and you have a team of 20, there's two or three who you just don't get along with in terms of hanging out," Hazlewood said in an interview in News Corp newspapers.

"You get on with each other to a professional point of view... and I didn't hate them or avoid them at all costs, but I didn't go out of my way to hang out with them.
"It wasn't the closest team. It's been thrown around now about bowlers versus batters, but at that point in time, it might have been true to a degree."
Hazlewood said he had no issue with either the publication or timing of Khawaja's book 'Sabr'.
"Nothing really sat badly with me... If that's how he wants to portray things and tell his story, then go for it," he added.
Cricket Australia attempted to draw a line under the revived scandal on Wednesday by announcing an independent forum for all the players to give their accounts of what happened in 2018 without fear of sanction.

ICE arrests by masked agents at US airport sparks outcry from politicians, officials

ICE said it was attempting to arrest a Mexican national who had overstayed his visa. A second passenger allegedly threw hot coffee at the agents and was also arrested.

Michael Marois

An arrest by federal immigration agents at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport sparked outrage among officials and politicians Saturday, and intensified scrutiny of Immigration and Customs Enforcement as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress and investigate the agency’s tactics.

Masked federal agents confronted passengers on a jet bridge as they boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles, forcing a woman to the ground in a chaotic encounter captured on video. The confrontation delayed the flight. The Port of Seattle said it was “outraged” by the incident, which involved ICE and two passengers.

ICE said its officers were attempting to arrest Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, a Mexican national who they said had overstayed his visa, when other passengers interfered with the operation. The agency said a second passenger, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, allegedly threw hot coffee at officers and was also arrested. She will be charged with assaulting a federal officer, according to ICE.

Show Full Article

Alaska Airlines said in an emailed statement that it had no advance notice of the enforcement action and was working to determine whether proper protocols were followed. The airline said it was concerned by the incident, which it described as distressing for passengers and employees, and emphasized that it doesn’t direct or coordinate immigration enforcement.

“I’m outraged by disturbing video of ICE agents forcing a woman to the ground on a jet bridge at SeaTac,” Senator Patty Murray, a Washington Democrat, said in a post on X. “Trump answers to a Democratic Congress on January 3rd — there WILL be accountability.”

Democrats are preparing to take control of both chambers of Congress in January, promising investigations into President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown. Lawmakers have identified ICE’s enforcement practices, treatment of detainees and use of federal authority among the targets of planned congressional oversight, which could include hearings, subpoenas and demands for agency records.

In October, undercover federal immigration agents arrested a woman at Los Angeles International Airport in another encounter captured on video.

Washington Governor Bob Ferguson, also a Democrat, called Saturday’s incident “just the latest example of ICE’s deeply un-American tactics,” saying the agency was “completely and totally out of control.”

The Port of Seattle said in a statement that immigration enforcement actions at the airport occur without its participation or knowledge. The Port said it was discussing with the Department of Homeland Security whether previously agreed protocols had been breached and was seeking more information from federal officials.

FAST

Nov 21 : Goals from Vanessa DiBernardo and Debinha lifted the Kansas City Current past the Washington Spirit 2-1 for their first NWSL Championship title on Saturday at Audi Field in Washington D.C.
DiBernardo scored direct from a corner early in the second half and Debinha added another from a superb solo effort in stoppage time, tuning out the noise from the partisan fans at the raucous "Rowdy Audi" venue.
Spirit forward Trinity Rodman clawed one back a minute later but exited the pitch in tears as Washington finished runners-up for the third year in a row.
"We knew it was going to be a battle, we felt good coming out of the first half," said DiBernardo, who was named the championship MVP. "We just had to be patient and finish off the game."

The two sides combined for 19 fouls across a chippy first half, where Rodman was left writhing in pain after a hard challenge by Current defender Laney Rouse in the fifth minute. 
Spirit goalkeeper Sandy MacIver made a brave stop in the 11th minute, getting in front of Current attacker Temwa Chawinga's fierce strike.
Rodman repeatedly grasped at her left shoulder in the first half and emerged from the changing room after the break with the area bandaged.
DiBernardo opened the scoring in the 54th minute, curving her corner kick over MacIver's head and straight into the goal to spark celebration among her teammates.
Spirit nearly equalised from a corner in the 75th minute but Current keeper Lorena jumped on the ball just inches from goal.
Lorena was forced to come off her line 10 minutes later before punching the ball out and colliding with Rodman. Both players sat on the pitch for at least two minutes to collect themselves before resuming the match.
Chawinga connected with Debinha in stoppage time and the Brazilian went streaking down the pitch before slotting the ball past MacIver to silence the crowd.
Washington poured forward and saw a glimmer of hope in Rodman's late header but could not break down the Current defence in the last moments. 
The championship kicked off after a pitch controversy nearly saw a Division III collegiate American football game displace the Spirit from their home stadium for the semi-finals a week ago.
A reminder of the controversy remained on the turf on Saturday with the gridiron markings still visible.
NWSL Commissioner Jessica Berman promised this week that work would be done to avoid such issues in the future.

items.title: テニス＝ＡＴＰファイナル、決勝はズベレフ対アルカラス
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの今季ツアー最終戦、ＡＴＰファイナルは２１日、イタリアのトリノで準決勝を行い、決勝は世界ランキング１位のアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）と世界３位のカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）という顔合わせになった。

ズベレフは第４シードでロシア出身のダニル・メドベージェフと対戦し、第１セットはタイブレークで７ポイントを連取して７─６でものにすると、第２セットは６─４で勝利。今大会では１セットも落とさずに決勝まで進んだ。

自身３回目のＡＴＰファイナル制覇を目指すズベレフは「どちらも信じられないほど素晴らしいサーブを打っていたので、（ブレークポイントは）ほとんどなかったような気がする。彼（メドベージェフ）をたたえたい」と話した。

アルカラスは第３シードのベン・シェルトン（米国）に３─６、６─３、７─６で逆転勝利。「第２セットでいいプレーをして巻き返せたのがとにかくうれしい。タイブレークでも素晴らしいテニスができて満足している。この勝利には大きな意味がある。明日が楽しみだ。今日は全てに満足している」と話した。

アルカラスは優勝すればＡＴＰファイナル初タイトル。ズベレフとの対戦成績は７勝６敗としており、ことしの全豪オープン準決勝でもフルセットの末に勝利を収めている。

items.title: サッカー＝レアル、エムバペＰＫ失敗もセルタに逆転勝ち
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は２１日、各地で試合を行い、レアル・マドリードがセルタに２─１で勝利し、翌日に試合を控える首位バルセロナと暫定ながら勝ち点３３で並んだ。

前半６分に失点したレアルは、同３９分にキリアン・エムバペが自ら得たＰＫで同点のチャンスを得るも、これを失敗。同選手がレアルとフランス代表での試合中にＰＫを外したのは直近６回中これが３回目となった。

レアルは後半２１分、エムバペのアシストからジュード・ベリンガムが同点弾をマークすると、同４０分にカルロス・エスピが決勝ゴールを決めた。

佐藤龍之介が所属するバレンシアはラヨ・バリェカノに１─０で勝利し、暫定１７位に浮上して降格圏内を脱出。佐藤はベンチ入りしたが出番はなかった。

その他、セビリアとベティスのダービーは１─１のドロー。アラベスはデポルティボに３─１で勝利した。

items.title: ノルディックスキー＝Ｗ杯ジャンプ個人第1戦で小林陵8位、丸山9位
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - ノルディックスキーのワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）ジャンプは２１日、リレハンメルで男女の個人第１戦（ヒルサイズ＝ＨＳ１４０メートル）を行い、男子では小林陵侑が８位だった。

小林は１回目に１３５メートル、２回目に１２６．５メートルを飛び、合計２４４．２点だった。シュテファン・エンバハー（オーストリア）が合計２７８．０点で優勝した。中村直幹は１１位、佐藤幸椰は２３位。二階堂蓮は２回目に進めず、３７位に終わった。

女子では丸山希が合計２１６．８点で９位。宮嶋林湖は１１位、勢藤優花は１４位、伊藤有希は１９位で、高梨沙羅は２回目に進めずに３５位だった。優勝したアイリンマリア・クバンダルを含め、５位までノルウェー勢が独占した。

items.title: Anthropic's post-debut stumble delivers reality check for AI trade
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic’s shares fell about 9% after their market debut, deepening concerns over stretched AI valuations and showing that even a marquee listing has not revived investor enthusiasm for the sector. The focus is now shifting to whether Anthropic can justify its roughly 40-times-sales valuation and whether a potential OpenAI IPO next year can restore appetite for AI stocks.
items.body: Anthropic's post-listing slide deepened the gloom over the AI sector on Friday, underscoring how even one of the most eagerly anticipated listings in history has struggled to revive investor enthusiasm.Widely seen as a proxy for the AI trade, Anthropic's listing had been viewed as a potential boost for an industry struggling to regain momentum after a turbulent stretch.But the stock was last trading at $88.87, about 9% below where it closed following Thursday's smooth debut, giving Anthropic a fully diluted valuation of about $1.6 trillion and a market capitalization of $1.2 trillion based on shares outstanding.The stock could find support later in the year. London-based index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates index-tracking funds could account for purchases of up to 30% of Anthropic's shares by year-end.Near-term volatility, however, could persist as the initial euphoria around the listing fades and investors assess whether a valuation of about 40 times sales over the past 12 months can be sustained. We favor patience on Anthropic and recommend evaluating the company as it reports public results, said Kaush Amin, head of private market investing at US Bank Asset Management, adding that the current valuation assumes years of rapid growth. The debut has also done little to ease broader concerns about the health of the AI trade. Wall Street's main indexes ended sharply lower on Thursday, while futures pointed to further declines on Friday.Among the Magnificent Seven stocks, Nvidia and Meta Platforms fell more than 2% each in premarket trading, while Amazon and Microsoft dropped more than 1%.Chip stocks also slid, with AMD and Sandisk down 7% each and Intel losing more than 5%.The focus now shifts to a potential OpenAI listing, which would be another major test of investors' appetite for AI stocks. OpenAI has indicated it may go public next year.PARALLELS WITH SPACEXAnthropic's IPO has drawn parallels with Elon Musk's SpaceX , which went public in June after the second-biggest IPO on record.While the companies have different business models, some investors have pointed to SpaceX's sharp swings in the weeks after its debut as a reason for caution over buying Anthropic immediately after its listing. There's going to be some volatility like we had with SpaceX. A lot of people are going to have FOMO. I don't think there's any need to get on it on the first trade, said Rob Hackel, CEO of financial advisory and brokerage firm RF Lafferty & Co.SpaceX shares fell about 5%.Retail investors traded about $772 million of Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most for an IPO debut since Vanda Research began tracking the data in 2012.The stock's sharp swings have left investors weighing whether to bet on a rebound or brace for further losses. Options trading, due to begin next week, could add to the volatility. It's not a good environment for Anthropic at the moment, said Carsten Hesse, head of index events at Berenberg.Competition could also weigh on investor sentiment.Apple is developing an AI agent that can perform tasks on behalf of users, entering a market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.

Mexico City: Mexican military forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro,” one of the FBI’s 10 most wanted fugitives, and two other leaders of his drug-trafficking organization in Sinaloa state on Friday night, Mexico’s security chief said on Saturday.

For over 20 years, according to the US State Department, Meza Flores and his criminal organization smuggled vast amounts of heroin, methamphetamine, cocaine and marijuana into the United States.

He was considered one of the leaders of the Beltran Leyva cartel, previously a rival of the Sinaloa cartel. After Sinaloa cartel founder Ismael “El Mayo” Zambada was taken into US custody in 2024, infighting began between two factions for control of the cartel, Los Chapitos and Los Mayos. Meza Flores’ Beltran Leyva had recently allied with the Los Mayos faction, security experts say.

Show Full Article

The arrest is the latest in a string of captures and killings of high-profile suspected drug traffickers by Mexico, which is under pressure from US President Donald Trump. He has threatened unilateral military action inside Mexico if the government does not do more against the cartels.

Overnight on Friday, the military operation sparked a wave of violence in the state of Sinaloa, including armed clashes between Mexican security forces and cartel members, who set up flaming roadblocks in some areas.

Social media videos from Guasave, Sinaloa, where Meza Flores was captured on Friday night, showed Mexican security force helicopters firing at ground targets, residents scrambling to seek cover at a baseball game and others hiding for safety by a night market.

UNITED STATES-MEXICO INTELLIGENCE COOPERATION

Special forces from Mexico’s army and National Guard carried out the capture in coordination with US and Mexican intelligence agencies, Mexico’s Defense Ministry said in a post on X. The post said cartel members had set up roadblocks in nearby municipalities, but that security forces were deployed alongside local authorities to clear them.

“The exchange of strategic intelligence between the United States and Mexico helped make this operation possible,” US Ambassador to Mexico Ronald Johnson wrote in a post on X, applauding Mexican security forces. “Results like these are not achieved overnight. They are the product of sustained cooperation and trust. This is what we can accomplish when we work together. We will continue pursuing criminals.”

Several US agencies applauded the operation. Homeland Security Investigations said on X that the operation was “a MAJOR blow to one of Mexico’s most powerful cartel networks.” US Northern Command congratulated Mexican forces, saying that its counter-cartel task force had worked with other US interagency partners on information that led to the capture.

Four Mexican Army infantry soldiers died in the operation, the Defense Ministry said in a statement posted on X that extended the institution’s condolences to the families.

The statement added that security forces killed seven attackers and arrested eight alleged criminals in the operation, including three transferred to Mexico City and five who were turned over to the Attorney General’s Office in Culiacan, Sinaloa.

Meza Flores and his cousin, who was the second-in-command within the Beltran Leyva criminal organization, were taken to Mexico City at 5:20 a.m. (1120 GMT) and handed over to the Specialized Prosecutor’s Office for Organized Crime. Also arrested and handed over was Meza Flores’ brother-in-law, who was his financial operator.

Security minister Omar Garcia Harfuch also extended his condolences to the families of the killed soldiers in a post on X and added that authorities seized, among other weapons, a .50-caliber rifle, a grenade launcher and two hand grenades in the operation.

VIOLENCE SUBSIDES BY SATURDAY

While Friday night social media posts showed scenes of roadblocks, cars being burned and a local reporter being forced to scramble for cover amid a  gunfight, by Saturday the violence had substantially subsided.

Sinaloa state authorities said “the situation is under control and being addressed by all levels of government.” They added that they were monitoring highways and urban and rural areas of Guasave. Activities were focused on restoring mobility, and residents could resume normal activities, they said.

According to a local security official, there was a nervous atmosphere in the city as residents had been sheltering in place since Friday night. Businesses remained closed and streets were deserted, but there were no current bouts of generalized violence, the official said.

items.title: ラグビー＝ネーションズ選手権、日本はスコットランドに大敗
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［エディンバラ　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［エディンバラ　２１日　ロイター］ - ラグビーの強豪１２カ国・地域で争う国際大会、ネーションズ選手権は２１日、英国のエディンバラなどで試合を行い、世界ランキング１２位の日本代表は同６位のスコットランド代表に５─６７で大敗した。

日本はスピードとパワーで圧倒され、合計１１トライを献上。前半に０─２９と大差をつけられると、後半にも失点を重ね、松永拓朗による１トライにとどまった。

同大会では北半球と南半球のチームが戦い、南の一員として参戦している日本は１勝５敗で５位。北のスコットランドは４勝２敗で４位となった。

エディー・ジョーンズ・ヘッドコーチ率いる日本は１１月に入って３戦全敗。７日はウェールズに２１─２８で敗れ、１４日はイングランドに１５─７８の完敗を喫していた。

items.title: サッカー＝坂元が強烈ミドルで今季2点目、コベントリーがパレス下す
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マンチェスター（英国）　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［マンチェスター（英国）　２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは２１日、各地で試合を行い、坂元達裕がフル出場したコベントリーが鎌田大地フル出場のクリスタルパレスに３─２で競り勝った。

コベントリーは１─１と追い付かれて迎えた前半３０分、ペナルティーエリアの外でボールを受けた坂元が胸トラップから左足で強烈なミドルシュートをたたき込み、リーグ戦今季２ゴール目。チームは同アディショナルタイムに再び同点とされたが、最後は相手のオウンゴールで勝利を収めた。

最下位のクリスタルパレスはこれで今季８敗目。トーマス・フランク監督の初陣を白星で飾ることができなかった。クリスタルパレスの冨安健洋はベンチ外。

田中碧が先発したリーズはチェルシーを４─１で撃破。前半２５分に先制されたが、ノア・オカフォーの２ゴールなどで逆転勝利を収めた。チェルシーはリーグ戦直近４試合で３敗目となった。田中は後半４１分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラはサンダーランドとスコアレスドローに終わった。前田大然が先発し後半１１分までプレーしたイプスウィッチは、トットナムに０─２で完敗した。

アーセナルはニューカッスルと２─２の引き分けに終わり、勝ち点を積み上げるチャンスを逸した。マンチェスター・シティーはフラムと１─１のドローで試合を終え、リーグ戦４連敗を免れた。

１１試合消化時点で首位アーセナルは勝ち点２８。リーズは同１７として６位に浮上した。コベントリーは同１２で１３位となった。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第５戦、フィンランディア杯は２１日、フィンランドのヘルシンキで競技を行い、男子では友野一希が合計２３７．７５点で３位に入った。

前日のショートプログラム（ＳＰ）で５位だった友野は、この日に行われたフリーでは４位だった。

ミハイル・セレブコ（エストニア）がＳＰに続き、フリーでも１位となり、合計２５４．９９点でＧＰ初優勝を達成。ファイナル進出を決めた。アンドレアス・ノルデバック（スウェーデン）がＳＰ同様、フリーでも３位となり、合計２４０．９４点の２位だった。

items.title: メキシコ、麻薬組織の首領を拘束　米当局が協力
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sarah Kinosian

[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sarah Kinosian

[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] - メキシコ当局は２１日、軍が２０日夜に麻薬組織の首領ファウスト・イシドロ・メサフロレス容疑者（通称エル・チャポ・イシドロ）を北西部シナロア州で拘束したと発表した。容疑者は米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）の最重要指名手配者１０人の一人。

メキシコ国防省はＸへの投稿で、軍の特殊部隊と国家警備隊による拘束作戦には米国の情報機関も協力したと明らかにした。メキシコ政府はトランプ米政権の圧力を受け、麻薬組織の取り締まりを強化している。

米国務省によると、メサフロレス容疑者とその麻薬組織「ベルトラン・レイバ」は２０年以上にわたり、ヘロイン、メタンフェタミン、コカイン、マリフアナ（大麻）を米国へ大量に密輸してきた。内部抗争が起きている別の麻薬組織「シナロア・カルテル」の派閥の一つと協力関係にあるという。

米国土安全保障捜査局（ＨＳＩ）はＸで、この作戦が「メキシコで最も強力なカルテルネットワークの一つに重大な打撃を与えた」と投稿。米北方軍もメキシコ軍を称えた。

FAST

CARDIFF, Nov 22 : Wallabies coach Les Kiss hailed Australia's defensive efforts after they held on for a 29-26 win over Wales on Saturday to snap a four-match losing streak and earn a first win in Europe for two years. 
Australia's reward is a playoff for fifth place in the Nations Championship against Ireland at Twickenham on Friday and a chance to end their season on a real high.
The Wallabies shipped 153 points over their four straight losses and Kiss was delighted with his team's display even if Wales, on a high after beating the All Blacks last week, ran in four tries on Saturday to set up a dramatic finish.
"It was a ding dong battle, wasn't it?" Kiss said in a pitchside interview.

"But full credit to Wales after last week's effort to come out with the energy they did tonight was unbelievable but I'm really happy for the boys. 
"The work they've been putting in for the last three or four weeks has been unbelievable. You can't question their work, and I'm really happy that they got something out of that tonight."
Kiss rejigged his pack for Saturday's test and was rewarded with a strong defensive effort, particularly in the first half when the Wallabies held up Wales over the line twice.  
"Our defence continued to step up, that's for sure," Kiss added in his post-match press conference. 
"Set piece stayed solid. A couple of decisions here or there, I guess. But, five meters out from your line, it's hard to defend those mauls. Defence generally really stepped up." 
Kiss also thought the Wallabies had played a smarter tactical game on Saturday even if disciplinary lapses were still an issue.   
"I think we managed the kicking game better aerially and also just turning the game a little bit and probably pulled the trigger more accurately," he said. 
"I'm still not completely happy. The boys aren't completely happy. They're talking about missed opportunities ... but I thought there was some improvement in that area.
"Discipline was a little bit disappointing, I must say, kept (Wales) in the game and (gave them) field position. So we're going to have to have a look at that as well."  

Source: Reuters

Australia criticises US Congressional Budget Office over AUKUS comments

SYDNEY, Nov 22 (Reuters) – Australian Defence Minister Richard Marles on Sunday criticised the United States Congressional Budget Office over a report that said the AUKUS pact would decrease the number of attack submarines available to the US Navy.

“They are wrong,” Marles said, referring to the CBO, which said in the report this month that the sale of Virginia-class submarines to Australia could diminish the size of the navy’s attack submarine force through to 2060.  

AUKUS, Australia’s largest-ever defence project, will put US-commanded Virginia-class submarines in Australia from next year, involves selling several Virginia-class submarines to Australia from around 2030 and will have Britain and Australia build a new class of AUKUS nuclear-powered submarine. 

Show Full Article

Marles was not worried about the report “because AUKUS is very much happening” and “the production rate in the United States is absolutely increasing”, he said in televised remarks.

In October, Marles said Australia remained on track to acquire its first nuclear-powered subs from the US in the early 2030s.

The CBO did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside regular business hours.

Canberra has committed A$368 billion ($243 billion) over three decades to AUKUS, including billions of dollars in investment in British and US production bases.

Formed in 2021, AUKUS is part of efforts to counter China’s growing influence in the Indo-Pacific. China has called the pact dangerous and warned it could spur a regional arms race.

($1 = 1.5117 Australian dollars)

(Reporting by Sam McKeith in Sydney; Editing by Matthew Lewis)

Bahrain said on Saturday (Nov 21) that an Iranian attack had hit a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire but no injuries, while Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they launched a missile-and-drone attack on US military positions in the kingdom, home to the US Navy's Fifth Fleet.
The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February. Since then, Gulf Arab states have been drawn into the conflict, and there have been repeated Iranian attacks across the region.
Civil Defence teams were working to contain the fire at the industrial facility, the ministry said in a post on X. It gave no details on the location or nature of the site.
Bahrain's interior ministry initially issued an alert urging residents to move to the nearest safe location because of a potential threat, without providing details. It later issued an all-clear before sending a second alert.

Later, Bahrain's Defence Force said its air defences had intercepted a number of Iranian aerial attacks. Shrapnel from the interceptions caused material damage but no casualties, it said, adding that Tehran was continuing its "systematic hostile approach" towards the kingdom.
The Revolutionary Guards, in a statement carried by Iranian state news agency IRNA, said their aerospace forces had launched a combined missile-and-drone attack on US positions at the Al-Riffa and Awali bases "in retaliation for ongoing aggression and repeated violations of Iranian airspace".
US Central Command did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on the Guards' account.
Bahrain has reported intercepting several Iranian aerial attacks in recent days. Gulf Arab states have come under repeated fire from Tehran since the war broke out.

FAST

Nov 22 : New Zealand were 119-2 at the close of play as they fought to save the first test after India declared on 720-9 with an imposing first-innings lead of 352 on the fourth day in Wellington on Sunday.
Rishabh Pant earlier scored a century as India, desperate for points to stay in the race for the World Test Championship final, put the tiring home bowlers to the sword to bump up their record tally ahead of the declaration.
New Zealand's hopes of a result rest on batting for much of the remainder of the match and forcing a draw despite losing Tom Latham for a duck and first-innings centurion Henry Nicholls for 31.   
Opener Devon Conway, who scored his 22nd test half-century on his way to an unbeaten 59, and Rachin Ravindra (27 not out) will resume on day five with the Black Caps still 233 runs from forcing India to bat again.

India's pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah (1-33) again made an early breakthrough by sending Latham back from the second ball of the innings, the New Zealand skipper edging behind to take a pair. 
Nicholls, whose 175 was the backbone of New Zealand's first-innings 368, got an edge and a bit of thigh pad on a Prasidh Krishna delivery and Dhruv Jurel showed stunning reflexes to take the catch at short leg.
Jurel had earlier become the sixth batter to score a half century in India's innings before being caught in the deep for 78, triggering the declaration an hour before tea. 
BOOMING SIX
India had resumed on 486-4 on another sunny morning at the Basin Reserve with the clear intent of pushing their 118-run lead out to the sort of tally that would take the possibility of a New Zealand victory out of the equation.
There are few better batters for such a task than Pant and the swashbuckling wicketkeeper showed the full range of his shots as he approached his ninth test hundred.
"I just wanted to stay there as long as possible and just make my impact," Pant said.
"I just keep it simple most of the time. Whenever I see the ball, I try to hit it. I think that if it's in my area, I'll try to hit it for sure."  
He reached the milestone with a booming six over long-off and two more soon afterwards took him to 108 sixes in his test career, the most of any batter apart from England's Ben Stokes (138).
"Mostly whenever I'm trying to get 100, I try to get it with a six. But because of that, I've also missed a lot of hundreds," Pant added.
"So I was very patient about it, but when the mid-off came up, I was like, 'This is the right opportunity. I might take it'."  
Pant was finally caught on the boundary for 128 off the bowling of Ravindra to bring up lunch but the punishment for New Zealand continued into the second session.
India's final score was well clear of their previous best innings tally in New Zealand of 520 all out in Hamilton in 2009 - a match they won by 10 wickets. 
All-rounder Glenn Phillips (3-154) picked up a couple of wickets as the Indian batters went for their shots ahead of the declaration to make his figures a bit more respectable. 
Seamer Jacob Duffy, though, finished with unenviable figures of 1-201 from his 33 overs, only 28 runs shy of New Zealand's most expensive ever bowling display, which spinner Stephen Boock tallied against Pakistan in 1989.

PARIS, Nov 22 : France coach Fabien Galthie hailed his side's run to the inaugural Nations Championship final as a "tour de force" after Les Bleus overcame a lengthy injury list to set up a showdown with South Africa.
The Six Nations champions booked their place in the final with a 45-17 bonus-point victory over Argentina at the Stade de France on Saturday.
France were without several key players during the Northern Series of the competition, including fullback Thomas Ramos and second-row pair Thibaud Flament and Emmanuel Meafou.
The French side also endured an injury crisis at flyhalf, with Matthieu Jalibert only returning on Saturday after a two-month absence and Romain Ntamack dislocating his shoulder against Fiji earlier this month.

"We are very, very happy to be in the final," Galthie said.
The France coach highlighted the 12 points his side collected from their opening three Nations Championship tests in July.
"We won five matches and lost one in New Zealand by two points, with the attacking and defensive bonus point," Galthie said.
"We earned four attacking bonus points from those five wins, an incredibly difficult challenge. Reaching the final, the players achieved a feat that should not be taken for granted.
"It was a tour de force."
France will face South Africa for the second time in just over two weeks in next Sunday's final at Twickenham after Galthie's side stunned the four-time world champions 21-19 earlier this month.
"It's always a big physical battle, because they always want to dominate their opponent physically," captain Antoine Dupont said.
"They have a defence that applies a lot of pressure."

items.title: ゴルフ＝ＣＭＥツアー選手権、吉田が首位と1打差の2位に浮上
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフの今季最終戦、ＣＭＥツアー選手権は２１日、フロリダ州ネープルズのティブロンＧＣ（パー７２）で第３ラウンドを行い、吉田優利が２位に浮上した。

３位でスタートした吉田は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６６をマーク。通算１７アンダーの１９９に伸ばし、単独首位の金阿林（韓国）とは１打差につけた。

岩井明愛は５バーディー、ノーボギーの６７でラウンドし、通算１５アンダーの６位に浮上。山下美夢有も６７で回り、通算１４アンダーの７位に順位を上げた。

竹田麗央は通算１２アンダーの１５位。西郷真央と古江彩佳は通算８アンダーの２６位。西村優菜は通算６アンダーの３３位。岩井千怜と勝みなみは３７位、原英莉花と畑岡奈紗は４４位となった。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ラスベガス　２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ラスベガス　２０日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の第２１戦、ラスベガス・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２０日、予選を行い、マックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）がポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

総合優勝４回を誇るフェルスタッペンのＰＰ獲得は今季３回目で、キャリア通算５１回目。

すでに史上最年少での総合優勝を決めているキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が最速タイムを計測したが、エンジン関連のペナルティーで５グリッド降格し、決勝では６番手からスタートする。

これを受けて、２番手のフェルスタッペン、３番手のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）、４番手のランド・ノリス（英国、マクラーレン）、５番手のアイザック・ハジャー（フランス、レッドブル）、６番手のアービッド・リンドブラッド（英国、レーシングブルズ）がそれぞれ１つずつ繰り上がる。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第５戦、フィンランディア杯は２１日、フィンランドのヘルシンキで競技を行い、女子では島田麻央が第２戦のスケートカナダに続く２連勝を達成。シリーズ上位６人で争われるＧＰファイナル（中国・重慶で１２月１０─１２日に開催）初進出を決めた。

ショートプログラム（ＳＰ）首位の島田は、この日のフリーでは冒頭のトリプルアクセル（３回転半ジャンプ）に成功。さらにステップやスピンで最高難度のレベル４を獲得するなどし、合計２２９．４９点をマークした。

日本選手によるＧＰデビューからの２連勝は２０１８年の紀平梨花以来で、２人目となった。今季ＧＰシリーズでは日本勢が５戦全勝。第１戦と第４戦では中井亜美、第３戦では千葉百音が優勝した。

ニーナ・ペトロキナ（エストニア）が合計２１４．０６点で２位、イザボー・レビト（米国）が合計２０７．１９点で３位に入った。住吉りをんは７位、渡辺倫果は１０位に終わった。

items.title: A 10% drop for the stock market is unnerving, but it's not that unusual
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: The U.S. stock market has dropped 10 per cent from its high set last month amid concerns about the growing hurdles faced by the high-flying artificial intelligence industry.
items.body: The U.S. stock market has dropped 10 per cent from its high set last month amid concerns about the growing hurdles faced by the high-flying artificial intelligence industry. The fall for the S&P 500 is steep enough that Wall Street has a name for it: a “correction.” Such drops have happened regularly for more than a century, and market pros often view them as potentially healthy wipeouts of overdone euphoria, which could send stock prices too high if unchecked. But corrections are unnerving in the moment. And the larger fear always accompanying a correction is that it could be a warning sign of a coming “bear market,” which is what Wall Street calls a drop of at least 20 per cent. Here’s a look at what history shows about past corrections, and what market watchers are expecting going forward. What’s behind this correction? Stocks tied to the artificial intelligence boom drove the markets to all-time highs in October. But a confluence of events caused investors to question whether the enthusiasm is overblown and if the AI industry can deliver on the lofty expectations. For one, investors are worried that stock prices in AI companies shot too high and that the strong demand for memory, processors and other building blocks of data centers could fizzle out if AI proves less profitable than promised. The large sums needed to invest in technology and data centers are another concern. The industry is racing to develop more capable models and infrastructure, which requires billions of dollars, but increasingly companies are having to raise money by selling bonds to investors. Now, the Federal Reserve is expected to hike its short-term interest rate next month. That could drive up borrowing costs for AI companies, among others. More recently, investors have grown anxious about the regulatory environment under a new Congress. Newly elected Democrats are vowing to crack down on the industry amid a backlash against data centers. And two big states offering incentives for data centers, Texas and Georgia, elected Democratic governors who have vowed to stop new construction. Then there’s Nvidia. The company’s chips power the AI industry and it also provides the cash that’s helped companies across the industry to grow. The sudden downfall of Jensen Huang, its former CEO and co-founder, has punished the company’s stock and been a big factor in the broader sell-off. “Jensen Huang’s departure may have been the catalyst for this sell-off, but the underlying concerns in the technology sector have been building for some time,” said Karan Ramchandani, managing partner at Post Oak Group. “Investors have poured enormous amounts of capital into AI based on expectations of transformational growth, and we’re now entering a period where those expectations need to translate into measurable earnings and returns.” Not even the blockbuster market debut of AI lab Anthropic this week could stem the selling. Was there a tech bubble? And has it burst? Given their lofty valuations, Wall Street has been anticipating a correction in AI stocks for a while. Some who’ve referred to the run-up in the stocks a bubble think it hasn’t popped completely. “The bubble is popping and it has much further to go,” said David Trainer, head of investment research firm New Constructs. “We’re in the early innings of reconciliation with economic reality of egregious over-investment in AI. Like all other booms, this one is having its bust.” Others see the sell-off as another instance of the fear and anxiety that periodically grips the markets. Dan Ives, a financial analyst at Yorkville Ives & Co., likened the current downturn to market corrections in March 2020 around the pandemic and in April 2025 following the Trump administration’s escalation of its global trade war. But he sees the selling as panic-driven, and not a “red flag moment indicating darker times ahead for tech and the market.” “This is a painful tech sell-off that is heavily discounting this 4th Industrial Revolution thesis will take place over the next few years,” Ives wrote. “And that is the wrong move in our view.” Ramchandani sees the sell-off as more of a reevaluation of the AI sector than the bursting of a bubble. “AI isn’t going away,” she said, “but the market may be entering a phase where investors become far more selective about which companies can actually deliver on the promises.” Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide, says the washout being led by AI stocks could ultimately prove constructive for the broader market. “If this evolves into a true flush, it may serve as the reset needed to improve positioning, sentiment, and the odds of a more sustainable rally into year-end,” he said, in a research note. How often do corrections occur? Every couple years, on average. Even during the historic, nearly 11-year-long bull market for U.S. stocks from March 2009 to February 2020, the S&P 500 stumbled to five corrections, according to research firm CFRA. Worries about everything from interest rates to trade wars to a European debt crisis caused the pullbacks. The U.S. market’s last correction was in March 2025. The last correction that did graduate into a bear market was in 2022. Through the 2022 bear market, the S&P 500 fell 25.4 per cent from Jan. 3 to Oct. 12. What typically happens after a drop like this? Looking at the 25 corrections since 1946 that managed to right themselves before turning into a bear market, the S&P 500 has taken an average of 130 days to hit bottom and lost an average of nearly 14.1 per cent along the way, according to CFRA. The index has taken an average of 112 days to recoup its losses. For the 14 declines that became bear markets, the damage is much worse. Going back to 1946, the average bear market has caused a loss of 32 per cent for the S&P 500, according to CFRA. ___ Alex Veiga, The Associated Press Business Writers Bernard Condon, Kaitlyn Huamani and Damian Troise contributed.

FAST

Nov 21 : Kylian Mbappe’s third miss in his last six penalty attempts for club and country did not prove costly as Carlos Espi’s late winner helped Real Madrid to a 2-1 home victory over Celta Vigo in LaLiga on Saturday.
Real have 33 points from 13 LaLiga games, level with leaders Barcelona, but have now played a game more. The Catalans are in action on Sunday at home to Villarreal.
Mbappe’s wastefulness from 12-yards had already cost Real a point earlier in the season and this time it was almost two as he lifted his effort well over the crossbar.
He also missed a penalty when the Madrid side lost 1-0 at Real Betis in September, and for France against Morocco in the World Cup.

On both those occasions he shot low and saw his effort saved, which perhaps might explain why he tried to go high this time round.
Celta took the lead inside six minutes when Pablo Duran scored from close range as he turned in Williot Swedberg's low cross.
Real had the chance to pull level when Mbappe had his arm pulled by Celta defender Javier Rodriguez and the referee pointed to the spot, but the Frenchman could not convert.
Real were level on 66 minutes as Jude Bellingham drilled the ball low into the net from just inside box.
It looked as though they would be frustrated before Espi’s initial header was saved by goalkeeper Ionut Radu, but he turned in the rebound.
Kike Salas equalised in added time at the end of the game as Sevilla played to a 1-1 draw with Real Betis in the Seville derby.
Antony netted for the visitors early in the second half with his first goal of the season but Betis were denied a place in the top three by the equaliser.
Deportivo Alaves ended an eight-game winless streak with a 3-1 home victory over Deportivo La Coruna.
Angel Perez opened the scoring for the hosts, but they were pegged back to 1-1 by an own goal from Nahuel Tenaglia.
Lucas Boye, who earlier missed a penalty, scored Alaves' second and the points were made safe when Denis Suarez netted in added time.
Valencia moved out of the bottom three with a 1-0 away win at Rayo Vallecano thanks to Jose Copete's first half headed goal.

items.title: Airbnb looks beyond traditional holiday hubs to deepen presence in India
items.summary: The company is looking to expand its reach beyond established leisure destinations such as Goa and hill stations, with growing interest in cultural, spiritual, nature-led and rural tourism ...
items.body:
Home / Companies / News / Airbnb looks beyond traditional holiday hubs to deepen presence in India

Airbnb looks beyond traditional holiday hubs to deepen presence in India The company is looking to expand its reach beyond established leisure destinations such as Goa and hill stations, with growing interest in cultural, spiritual, nature-led and rural tourism

Technology-led initiatives are another part of the strategy, with the company introducing AI-powered tools for searching, filtering and comparing homes, alongside features aimed at simplifying the hosting process (Photo: Reuters)

Press Trust of India New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Nov 22 2026 | 11:45 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Global hospitality platform Airbnb is looking to deepen its presence in India by expanding beyond traditional holiday destinations, strengthening the homestay ecosystem and bringing more local entrepreneurs onto its platform to tap the country's growing domestic travel market.
In an interview with PTI, Airbnb India Country Manager Amanpreet Bajaj said the company's India growth strategy will focus on expanding quality accommodation supply, enabling more communities to participate in tourism and diversifying its offerings beyond stays through experiences and services.
"We will also continue expanding quality supply, both in traditional leisure markets and metros and in emerging destinations such as spiritual corridors and nature-led locations. We want travellers to have more choices and local communities to benefit from tourism," Bajaj shared.
 

He highlighted that India is one of Airbnb's fastest-growing origin markets globally, with domestic travel emerging as a major growth driver. Over 85 per cent of bookings by Indian guests in the first half of 2026 were domestic, while almost 70 per cent of first-time bookers during the period were from Gen Z.
The company is looking to expand its reach beyond established leisure destinations such as Goa and hill stations, with growing interest in cultural, spiritual, nature-led and rural tourism.
Also Read

Delhi HC says restaurants, hotels cannot impose mandatory service charges

Elan Group, Marriott to bring Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy to Gurugram

Thomas Cook India expects demerger of resorts business by Oct 2027: MD

Juniper Hotels Q2FY27 net profit more than doubles to ₹37.2 crore

Chalet Hotels Q2 net profit rises 40% to ₹216 crore, revenue falls 32%

"We have a presence across India, and the travel map is widening as travellers look beyond traditional tourism hubs for nature, culture, heritage and local experiences," Bajaj said.

Destinations such as Kangra, East Khasi Hills and Srinagar, along with hill stations in Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand, are attracting attention, while Varanasi and Amritsar are emerging as important cultural and spiritual tourism destinations, he added.
As demand spreads to newer locations, Airbnb is also focusing on developing accommodation supply and building a stronger host ecosystem in these markets.
Its two-year memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Tourism is aimed at strengthening India's homestay ecosystem through host training, digital onboarding and destination promotion.
The company also conducts community meet-ups and training programmes to encourage more people to participate in tourism. It has piloted the Airbnb Entrepreneurship Academy in Goa to help prospective homestay hosts learn hospitality best practices and prepare to welcome guests.

Bajaj cited the company's long-standing partnership with the Self-Employed Women's Association (SEWA) in rural Gujarat, under which women have received training to open their homes to visitors.
He stressed that the economic benefits extend beyond the accommodation business.
"Hosts have also told us that welcoming visitors creates opportunities beyond the home: local young people can provide transport, artisans can sell their products, and shops and restaurants can benefit. That is the multiplier effect of tourism on a local economy," Bajaj said.
He shared that Airbnb will keep strengthening its core stays business while expanding what guests can do through experiences and services.
Technology-led initiatives are another part of the strategy, with the company introducing AI-powered tools for searching, filtering and comparing homes, alongside features aimed at simplifying the hosting process.

Airbnb has introduced more than 250 product enhancements for hosts over recent years, including tools for listing homes, pricing guidance, AI-powered photo tours and an interactive earnings dashboard.
The company wants to make hosting simpler while improving the quality and choice of accommodation available to travellers, Bajaj said.
"The goal is not simply to capture more demand, but to meet the evolving needs of a new generation of Indian travellers, with Airbnb options across different price points, places and travel occasions," he observed.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: Aluminium product makers seek zero import duty on raw metal ahead of Budget
items.summary: Manufacturers' body ALEMAI has written a letter to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, seeking to bring down the basic customs duty on primary aluminium to zero ...
items.body:
Home / Industry / News / Aluminium product makers seek zero import duty on raw metal ahead of Budget

Aluminium product makers seek zero import duty on raw metal ahead of Budget Manufacturers' body ALEMAI has written a letter to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, seeking to bring down the basic customs duty on primary aluminium to zero

The impact is particularly significant for MSMEs, for whom raw material prices constitute a substantial proportion of overall manufacturing costs | Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Nov 22 2026 | 11:17 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Ahead of the Union budget for 2027-28, aluminium product manufacturers have urged the government to allow duty-free imports of raw metal to boost domestic consumption and enhance the competitiveness of small enterprises.
Manufacturers' body ALEMAI has written a letter to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, seeking to bring down the basic customs duty on primary aluminium to zero, arguing that the current 7.5 per cent levy, which translates into an effective import duty of 8.25 per cent including social welfare surcharge, is hurting MSMEs (micro, small and medium enterprises) and domestic value addition.
"We respectfully request the government in the forthcoming Union Budget...the basic customs duty on primary aluminium under tariff heading 7601 (be reduced) from 7.5 per cent to 0 per cent," Aluminium Extrusion Manufacturers Association of India (ALEMAI) said in the letter.
  The measure, it said, can help strengthen the competitiveness of the country's downstream manufacturing ecosystem, encourage greater domestic value addition, support MSMEs, improve export competitiveness, and expand aluminium consumption across the economy.
India has established a globally competitive primary aluminium industry and has significant potential to expand domestic aluminium consumption. However, the downstream aluminium sector, comprising a large number of MSMEs, continues to face a structural cost disadvantage due to the prevailing tariff structure on primary aluminium, the principal raw material, it said.
Also Read

Hind Copper, SAIL, NMDC among 6 stocks on analysts radar amid metals slide

DGTR initiates anti-dumping probe into aluminium extrusion imports premium

Hindalco flags coal supply constraints, sees 5% rise in aluminium costs premium

CBAM: Let's get ready premium

Domestic demand for non-ferrous metals set to rise 8-9% in FY27 premium

Domestic primary aluminium prices are influenced by international prices and import-parity considerations. The customs duty applicable to imported primary aluminium consequently forms an important component of the domestic price benchmark, it said, adding that the issue has also been recognised by the Ministry of Mines in its Vision Document on Aluminium Sector 2025.
The document estimates that in 2022, India's downstream sector paid approximately USD 470 million more than necessary to domestic primary aluminium producers on account of import-parity pricing. The document notes that this additional expenditure came at the expense of the downstream sector's growth and investment.
The impact is particularly significant for MSMEs, for whom raw material prices constitute a substantial proportion of overall manufacturing costs. Higher input costs directly affect margins, capacity utilisation, investment decisions and the ability of Indian manufacturers to compete in both domestic and international markets.
Besides, downstream manufacturers increasingly face competition from finished and semi-finished products imported at preferential or zero-duty rates under India's free trade agreements. This creates an asymmetry and an inverted duty structure in which Indian manufacturers face higher input costs while competing against imported products that enter the country at lower or zero tariff rates.
Rationalising the customs duty on primary aluminium would help address this structural disadvantage and enable greater value addition within India. The proposed measure would reduce the input cost burden on downstream aluminium manufacturers, improve the competitiveness of MSMEs in export markets, and strengthen domestic manufacturing and value addition, it said.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: バーレーンの工業施設攻撃で火災発生、負傷者なし　イラン革命防衛隊「米軍施設標的」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - バーレーンは２１日、民間の工業施設がイランの攻撃を受け火災が発生したと発表した。負傷者はいない。一方、イランの精鋭部隊、イスラム革命防衛隊は、バーレーン国内の米軍陣地に対しミサイルと無人機による攻撃を実施したと表明した。

バーレーンには米海軍第５艦隊が拠点があり、ここ１週間、イランの攻撃を複数回受けている。

バーレーン内務省はＸへの投稿で、民間防衛隊が消火活動を行っていると明らかにした。施設の場所や事業内容などの詳細については明らかにしていない。

同省は２１日、具体的内容には触れず、潜在的な脅威があるとして住民に避難を呼びかける警報を発令。警報はいったん解除されたが、再び出された。

その後、バーレーン国防軍は、防空部隊がイランによる複数の空中攻撃を迎撃したと発表した。迎撃による破片で物的被害が出たものの、死傷者の報告はないとした。国防軍は、イラン政府がバーレーンに対する「組織的な敵対的アプローチ」を続けていると指摘した。

一方、イランの革命防衛隊は国営イラン通信（ＩＲＮＡ）が伝えた声明で、「継続的な侵略とイラン領空への度重なる侵犯に対する報復」として、リファー基地およびアワリ基地の米軍施設に対し、宇宙航空部隊がミサイルと無人機による複合攻撃を実施したと発表した。

米中央軍は、革命防衛隊の説明に関するロイターのコメント要請に現時点で回答していない。

items.title: ロシア貨物船に無人機攻撃、フィンランド領海に漂流　ウクライナ関与か
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Essi Lehto

［ヘルシンキ　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Essi Lehto

［ヘルシンキ　２１日　ロイター］ - ロシア軍と関係のあるロシアの貨物船が２１日、バルト海で無人機（ドローン）による攻撃を受けて火災を起こし、その後フィンランド領海に漂流した。フィンランドは、ウクライナによる攻撃の可能性が高いとしている。

貨物船は「スパルタ２」。ロシア国防省向けに物流サービスを提供している海運会社オボロンロジスティカと関係があり、米国の制裁対象になっている。

フィンランド国防軍によると、ロシアの飛び地カリーニングラードに向かっていた同船は、ロシア領ゴーグラント島の西の公海上で損傷した。これに先立ち、ロシア・レニングラード州知事が、ロシア国境から約３カイリの公海上で、貨物船が２機の無人機による攻撃を受けたと通信アプリ「テレグラム」で述べていた。

フィンランド軍のアキマウリ・フフティネン報道官は記者会見で「ウクライナが（攻撃の）背後にいる可能性が高い」と述べた。ただ、同船が標的となった理由は明らかでないとした。

ウクライナは今年に入り、ロシア北西部レニングラード州に向けて軍用無人機による波状攻撃を繰り返している。一部の無人機はバルト海地域の領空に入り込み、戦争が北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の領域に影響を及ぼしているとの懸念が出ている。

フィンランド当局によると、火災は２１日夜の時点で続いている。船がフィンランド領海内で停泊しているため同国が救助活動を主導しているが、最終的にはロシアの船舶が残骸をロシアにえい航する可能性もある。

フィンランド湾沿岸警備隊のミッコ・シモラ司令官は、救助活動中にロシアのヘリコプターがフィンランド領空を一時的に侵犯した疑いがあると指摘した。

国境警備隊のイリヤ・イリン司令官は２１日夜、公共放送ＹＬＥに対し、貨物船の乗組員１６人について、救命ボートで脱出して近くのロシア船に移り、ロシアに戻る途中だと明らかにした。

オルポ首相はＸに「戦争が近隣地域に波及しつつある。フィンランド当局は、無人機攻撃でロシアの商船が被弾したフィンランド湾の状況に対応している。ウクライナには侵略者と戦う権利がある」と投稿した。

スウェーデンのヨンソン国防相によると、事案発生後、フィンランドの指揮下で活動するスウェーデン軍の戦闘機が、フィンランドとＮＡＴＯの領土保全の確保に加わった。

エストニアのミハル首相はＸに「ロシアの侵略と戦うことの影響がバルト海に及んだ。侵略者に（侵略を）やめるよう求める新たなシグナルだ。だが、われわれのウクライナ支援を止めるものは何もない」と投稿した。

ウクライナ外務省、在フィンランドのロシア大使館はコメントの要請に応じていない。

items.title: Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland tightens security
items.author: CNA
items.summary: “The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas,” Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo says after a drone strike hits the Russian cargo ship Sparta II.
items.body:
Advertisement

World

Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland tightens security

“The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas,” Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo says after a drone strike hits the Russian cargo ship Sparta II.

The damaged Russian cargo ship Sparta II, in a location given as the Gulf of Finland, November 21, 2026. FINNISH BORDER GUARD/Handout via REUTERS

(Updated: 22 Nov 2026 05:11AM)

HELSINKI: A Russian cargo ship caught fire after being hit by drones in the Baltic Sea on Saturday ( Nov 21) and later drifted into Finnish waters, prompting Helsinki to impose temporary air and maritime restrictions and say Ukraine was probably behind the attack.
The Sparta II, bound for Russian exclave Kaliningrad , was damaged in international waters west of Russia's Gogland island, Finland 's Defence Forces said, corroborating an earlier account by Russian officials.
"It is likely that Ukraine...is behind (the attack)," Finnish armed forces spokesperson Aki-Mauri Huhtinen told a press conference, adding it was not clear why the vessel had been targeted.
Finland 's Border Guard said there was no danger to maritime traffic or people, that rescue units were at the scene, and that it was coordinating operations with neighbouring countries.
